lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hello again! Tilly here, and today's story is out of this world. It's all about <color=red>space</color>!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Read carefully, then answer four <color=red>questions</color>. Get them all right and four new books will zoom into the library!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Captain Rosa and her robot, Bolt, were flying their spaceship to the <color=red>planet</color> Mars to collect red dust for scientists back on Earth.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Halfway there, a warning light flashed. A tiny <color=red>meteor</color> had knocked the ship's antenna loose, so they could no longer send messages home.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Bolt floated outside in his magnetic boots and fixed the antenna with a roll of extra-strong tape. Rosa called it the bravest repair in the <color=red>galaxy</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: They reached Mars, filled three jars with dust and sent a <color=red>cheerful</color> message home: "Mission complete, and Bolt deserves a medal!"

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 1: Why were Rosa and Bolt flying to Mars?
choices: To collect red dust for scientists
lines.hint: Not quite. Look back at the first part of the story!
lines.correctText: Correct! They were collecting red dust for scientists.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 2: What knocked the antenna loose?
lines.hint: Not quite. Remember, they were out in space!
lines.correctText: Yes! A tiny meteor hit the ship.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 3: How did Bolt fix the antenna?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about what Bolt took outside.
lines.correctText: Right! A roll of extra-strong tape did the job.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 4: How many jars of dust did they fill?
lines.hint: Not quite. Check the last part of the story.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Brilliant, four out of four! Your reading is truly <color=red>stellar</color>. Four new books are heading to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: Thanks for joining my space adventure. The library is filling up <color=red>nicely</color>, so go and take a look!
